description: Rank the files tracked at HEAD by code-at-rest risk: bug-fix commits, churn, dependents and critical paths in the history lookback window (authors shown, not scored); returns { hotspots, warnings }, transitive dependents in the import graph (null when the language is not supported), and critical or blocked path flags. Use it to find where a codebase is most likely to break, or to pick files for reengineering or extra test coverage.

repoDir.description: Absolute path to the git repository (any directory inside the work tree).

top.description: How many files to return. Defaults to 20.

name: list_hotspots
title: List hotspots
